messages:
ana: Heads-up  Quick thread to align on the "Elastic Lane" idea: per-route metering, tiered latency lanes, and a metered add-on for burst tokens. Need launch criteria, contract language, and an initial pricing sketch. 20m sync at 11?

micah: 11 works. Quick ask: what does Elastic Lane actually guarantee vs. best-effort? We should avoid terms that imply hard isolation unless we sell dedicated pools.

sam: Product definition: Elastic Lane = prioritized routing + soft caps + optional burst bundle. Promise: documented SLO band per lane and deterministic fallback (to standard lane) when exhausted. No hard guarantees unless customer buys dedicated lanes (enterprise).

mohit: Engineering take: implement via weighted routing + per-tenant token buckets. Soft priority is cheap; hard isolation needs pool reservation and scheduler changes. Pilot: soft approach. Cost delta for pilot ~+15% infra.

ralph: Commercial suggestion: two buy modes: 1) Metered Burst Bundles (prepaid tokens with monthly expiry) and 2) Committed Band (reserve X qps for discount & higher priority). Map discounts to commit size.

legal: Drafting constraints: avoid words like "guaranteed" and "unlimited." Pilot addendum must include usage caps, conversion terms, liability carveouts, and a clause for sustained noisy neighbors. Also flag export-control for certain data.

ops-bot: Upload: top-routes-burst-summary.csv -> https://internal.redwood/exports/elastic-burst.csv (uploaded) :file_folder:

micah: Launch criteria proposal: (a) pilot with 3 paying customers across different workloads for 4 weeks, (b) billing + metering visible in console, (c) SLOs validated on eval set (no >4% quality regressions).

sam: Add requirement: automated fallback & rollback tested in staging with canary traffic. Also docs & public wording ready.

mohit: Instrumentation checklist: per-tenant token usage, per-route latency heatmaps, priority-weight traces, and a surge-depletion alert with runbook. Must be live before GA.

ralph: Pricing pilot: suggested 20% discount on metered bundles for pilots with a 2-month min commit. Sales feedback: pilots need a low friction convert path.

ana: (joining) action items:
- ana: schedule 11am sync and capture RFC stub
- micah: draft customer-facing description + roadshow bullet points (EOD)
- sam: pricing sketch mapping commit->discount + bundle sizes (tomorrow)
- mohit: infra delta + blockers + quick router snippet (24h)
- legal: pilot addendum skeleton (48h)
- ops-bot: attach perf traces and usage sample to thread

micah: For docs wording I propose: "Elastic Lane: prioritized routing with SLO bands and documented graceful fallback. Dedicated isolation available as an upgrade." Simple and sets expectations.

legal: I'll include conversion terms for pilots (automatic invoice on conversion) and a short trial-to-paid flow.

ana: OK I'll synthesize RFC after the meeting. We should avoid reusing existing SKU names. Next check-in T+4 days to review pilot contract and pricing. Thanks everyone.
